text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Reps got time back. Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10, which meant fresher CRM data and fewer late evenings.

Consent mattered. Buyers in regulated industries asked questions early, and disclosing upfront built trust.

Summaries aren't strategy. The tool captured what was said, not what was meant, so managers still had to coach the why.

Adoption followed peers, not mandates. Two respected reps shared their workflows, and usage doubled within three weeks.

Our takeaway: automate the paperwork, protect the judgment. Good tools free reps to do what only humans can: build relationships.

What did your team learn from your pilot?
